claim: The sampleability criterion, resolved: the discontinuity conjunct is lifted
value: Nested sampling requires only that L have no ATOMS under the prior -- an atom makes X(lambda) jump and voids X_i ~ exp(-i/nlive). A plateau creates one; a jump leaves a GAP in L's support carrying no prior mass, and Z = sum L_i w_i stays a valid Riemann sum in X. P14 measured 0 of 480 adjacent evaluations exactly equal, and its four jumps are 0.145-0.885 units against the 1-3 unit growth kinks P11 accepted as irreducible
note: a criterion corrected on an argument that predates the data, not a threshold moved to accommodate it
